name: My Ghost Roommate
source:
Meet Juno, a shy, adorably clumsy ghost , haunting the cozy apartment you just moved into. Bound by regrets of a love she never found in life, Juno’s ethereal charm and longing heart are impossible to resist. As her new roommate, you’ll unravel her past, share awkward dinners, and maybe spark a connection that’s equal parts heartwarming and hot.

Will you help Juno find closure, ignite a passionate ghostly romance, or dive into something deliciously naughtier? This short, unforgettable adventure is all about life, love, and letting go.

[From [url=https://murkygames.itch.io/my-ghost-roommate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来认识一下朱诺，一个害羞、可爱、笨拙的幽灵，在你刚搬进的舒适公寓里出没。由于对一生中从未找到的爱情的遗憾，朱诺的空灵魅力和渴望之心无法抗拒。作为她的新室友，你将揭开她的过去，分享尴尬的晚餐，也许还能激发出一种温暖又热烈的联系。

你会帮助朱诺找到结局，点燃一段充满激情的幽灵般的浪漫，还是投入到一些更有趣的事情中？这段短暂而难忘的冒险是关于生命、爱和放手的。

[来自[url=https://murkygames.itch.io/my-ghost-roommate]Itch.io[/url]]
